indexingNote: Published pages that have made no indexing decision: neither listed in sitemap.xml nor carrying <meta name="robots" content="noindex">. On a GitHub Pages PROJECT site robots.txt cannot help — the crawler reads the USER site's robots.txt in another repository, and Disallow blocks crawling rather than indexing, which stops a noindex tag from ever being seen. The tag is the only thing that works. Recorded 2026-08-22; shrinking this list belongs to the page's owner. Anything not listed here fails the gate.
iconsNote: Published pages with no <link rel="icon">. A browser given none asks for /favicon.ico on every load and gets a 404; this site ships app/favicon.svg, which a browser only finds when a page points at it. The four pages that are team-owned or Rensley's were fixed on 2026-08-22, and Product B's two on 2026-08-23 on the do-not-merge/b proposal branch (its stale second page was retired rather than fixed). The ones left are one line each for their owner. This list is meant to SHRINK, and it has.

rootNote: Tracked files at the repo root that the filing law does not name. The law reserves the root for what a new cloner needs in the first 30 seconds — README.md, CLAUDE.md, package.json, tsconfig.json and the product briefs — and says of anything answering no to all four of its questions: delete it rather than file it. Recorded 2026-08-22. The seven files of the older root site were DELETED on 2026-08-23 once it was verified dead: GitHub Pages reports build_type 'workflow' and the workflow uploads path: app, the live page's title matches app/index.html and not the root's, and /PulseStudio/staff-dashboard.html returns 404. Nothing under app/ referenced them — b-dashboard has its own staff-dashboard.css and .js, so those links always resolved within app/. Git history keeps them. This list is meant to SHRINK, and it did.
